claims.quote: Five Hundred Million People. There will people in America and its possessions by the lapse of another century.
claims.description: The population of America and its possessions will reach five hundred million by 2000.
claims.stated_time: by the lapse of another century

claims.quote: Nicaragua will ask for admission to our Union after the completion of the great canal.
claims.description: Nicaragua, then Mexico and other Latin American republics, will join the United States.

claims.quote: The American will be Taller by from one to two inches.
claims.description: Americans will grow one to two inches taller thanks to health reforms.

claims.quote: He will live fifty years instead of thirty-five as at present
claims.description: Average American lifespan will rise to fifty years.

claims.quote: The city house will practically be no more.
claims.description: People will live in suburbs and commute quickly and cheaply to offices.

claims.quote: There will be No C, X or Q in our every-day alphabet.
claims.description: The letters C, X and Q will be dropped as spelling becomes phonetic.

claims.quote: Russian will rank second.
claims.description: English will be the most widely spoken language, with Russian second.

claims.quote: Hot or cold air will be turned on from spigots to regulate the temperature of a house
claims.description: Central plants will pipe heated or cooled air to homes, like central air conditioning.

claims.quote: Mosquitoes, house-flies and roaches will have been practically exterminated.
claims.description: Mosquitoes, flies and roaches will be nearly eradicated by public health measures.

claims.quote: Food will be served hot or cold to private houses in pneumatic tubes or automobile wagons.
claims.description: Ready-cooked meals from central establishments will be delivered to homes, a form of takeout and food delivery.

claims.quote: Having one’s own cook and purchasing one’s own food will be an extravagance.
claims.description: Cooking at home will become a luxury as wholesale electric kitchens supply meals.

claims.quote: Liquid-air refrigerators will keep great quantities of food fresh for long intervals.
claims.description: Liquid-air refrigeration will preserve food for long periods.

claims.quote: Coal will Not be Used for Heating or Cooking.
claims.description: Coal will be replaced by electricity for heating and cooking.

claims.quote: Along the seacoast will be numerous reservoirs continually filled by waves and tides washing in.
claims.description: Tidal and wave power reservoirs along coasts and hydroelectric dynamos on rivers will generate electricity.

claims.quote: There will be No Street Cars in Our Large Cities.
claims.description: City traffic will move to subways, tunnels and elevated roads with automobile coaches, making cities quiet.

claims.quote: If there be a battle in China a hundred years hence snapshots of its most striking events will be published in the newspapers an hour later.
claims.description: Photographs will be telegraphed over any distance and published within an hour.

claims.quote: Photographs will reproduce all of Nature’s colors.
claims.description: Color photography will be achieved.

claims.quote: Trains will run two miles a minute, normally ; express trains one hundred and fifty miles an hour.
claims.description: Trains will average 120 mph, with express trains reaching 150 mph.

claims.quote: There will be cigar-shaped electric locomotives hauling long trains of cars.
claims.description: Electric locomotives will replace coal-burning engines on railroads.

claims.quote: Automobiles will have been substituted for every horse vehicle now known.
claims.description: Automobiles will replace horse-drawn vehicles entirely, and the horse will become scarce.

claims.quote: Exercise will be compulsory in the schools.
claims.description: Compulsory exercise and gymnasiums in schools and cities, with everybody able to walk ten miles.

claims.quote: Fast electric ships, crossing the ocean at more than a mile a minute, will go from New York to Liverpool in two days.
claims.description: Fast electric ocean liners will cross the Atlantic in two days.

claims.quote: Upon their under sides will be apertures expelling jets of air.
claims.description: Ships will ride on runners over a film of air to reduce friction, a kind of hydrofoil or air-cushion craft.

claims.quote: There will be Air-Ships, but they will not successfully compete with surface cars and water vessels for passenger or freight traffic.
claims.description: Airships will exist as war vessels and research craft but will not compete for passenger or freight traffic.

claims.quote: Giant guns will shoot twenty-five miles or more, and will hurl anywhere within such a radius shells exploding and destroying whole cities.
claims.description: Long-range artillery with a range of twenty-five miles will destroy whole cities.

claims.quote: Fleets of air-ships, hiding themselves with dense, smoky mists, thrown off by themselves as they move, will float over cities, fortifications, camps or fleets.
claims.description: Fleets of airships will bomb cities and armies from the air under smoke screens.

claims.quote: Huge forts on wheels will dash across open spaces at the speed of express trains of to-day.
claims.description: Armored mobile forts will charge across the battlefield, anticipating tanks.

claims.quote: Rifles will use silent cartridges.
claims.description: Rifles will fire silently.

claims.quote: Balloons and flying machines will carry telescopes of one-hundred-mile vision with camera attachments, photographing an enemy within that radius.
claims.description: Aerial reconnaissance with long-range cameras will photograph enemy forces.

claims.quote: The horse will have become practically extinct.
claims.description: Horses will become nearly extinct, kept only by the wealthy for sport.

claims.quote: Cattle and sheep will have no horns.
claims.description: Livestock will be bred hornless and optimized to produce meat, milk and wool.

claims.quote: Persons and things of all kinds will be brought within focus of cameras connected electrically with screens at opposite ends of circuits, thousands of miles at a span.
claims.description: Live long-distance television with synchronized sound will show distant events to audiences.

claims.quote: Wireless telephone and telegraph circuits will span the world.
claims.description: Wireless telephony will connect people worldwide, including ships at sea, with automatic switching.

claims.quote: Grand Opera will be Telephoned to private homes, and will sound as harmonious as though enjoyed from a theatre box.
claims.description: Live and recorded music will be broadcast over telephone lines to homes.

claims.quote: A university education will be free to every man and woman.
claims.description: Free university education will be available to all, with free supplies and health care for poor students.

claims.quote: Pneumatic tubes, instead of store wagons, will deliver packages and bundles.
claims.description: Pneumatic tube networks will deliver store purchases and mail to homes.

claims.quote: In cold weather he will place heat-conducting electric wires under the soil of his garden and thus warm his growing plants.
claims.description: Farmers will use electric soil heating and electric light to extend growing seasons.

claims.quote: Delicious oranges will be grown in the suburbs of Philadelphia.
claims.description: Scientists will adapt tropical fruits to grow in cooler climates.

claims.quote: Cranberries, gooseberries and currants will be as large as oranges.
claims.description: Fruits will be bred to enormous sizes and made seedless.

claims.quote: Melons, cherries, grapes, plums, apples, pears, peaches and all berries will be seedless.
claims.description: Most fruits will be bred seedless.

claims.quote: The milkweed will have been developed into a rubber plant.
claims.description: Milkweed will be bred as a domestic source of rubber.

claims.quote: Plants will be made proof against disease microbes just as readily as man is to-day against smallpox.
claims.description: Crops will be made disease-resistant through something like vaccination.

claims.quote: There will be black, blue and green roses.
claims.description: Flowers can be bred in any color, and scents transferred between flowers.

claims.quote: Drugs needed by the lungs, for instance, will be applied directly to those organs through the skin and flesh.
claims.description: Drugs will be delivered through the skin by electric current rather than swallowed.

claims.quote: The living body will to all medical purposes be transparent.
claims.description: Invisible rays will let physicians see and photograph living organs such as the beating heart.
